_comment: Retell agent config for the McFolling pilot. Import once MF_RETELL_API_KEY exists. Secrets are referenced by ${ENV_VAR}, never inlined. RM4 = human-sounding voice targets.

telephony._note: Pilot default = Retell-managed number. Twilio only if explicitly adopted (set provider=twilio + Twilio secrets).

voice._rm4_targets: Human-sounding acceptance: avg response latency < 1.5s, natural turn-taking (no overlap/cut-offs), passes Priscila blind-listen.

first_message: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant for McFolling Properties. This call is recorded for quality and safety — is that okay?
